title: Koala waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='16' fill='#8a9a8a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='16' fill='#8a9a8a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='11' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='11' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#a8b8a8'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#d8e8d8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='4' fill='#2a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4a5a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47.5' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#6a7a7a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 55 Q50 60 56 55' stroke='#4a5a5a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='22' fill='#a8b8a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='15' ry='15' fill='#d8e8d8'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='74' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8a9a8a' transform='rotate(15 30 74)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='62' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#8a9a8a' transform='rotate(-30 74 62)'/>
  <!-- waving paw -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='7' fill='#8a9a8a'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='48' r='2' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='47' r='2' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='51' r='2' fill='#f0b8a0'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8a9a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8a9a8a'/>
  <!-- motion lines near waving paw -->
  <path d='M88 44 Q92 42 94 45' stroke='#ffd870' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M89 50 Q93 49 95 52' stroke='#ffd870' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
